The '''archeologist's brush''' is an unbreakable [[Archaeology|brush]] sold by the [[Archaeologist|archaeologist]].

== Obtaining ==
=== Trading ===
A level 2 archaeologist sells it for one [[Obol|obol]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/cartographer/2/brush.json}}</ref>

{{Sources}}

== Usage ==
It works like a normal brush but never breaks. The name is spelled "Archeologist's" in game.
